values.note: Back-in (asphalt, ~45 ft) $30 a night, $150 a week, $450 a month; pull-through (~80 ft) $40 a night, $200 a week, $600 a month. Up to 6 people; $3 a night for each person over 6. Card payments carry a convenience fee.

values.note: Book a specific site online (Park With Us) or call the Parks Department at 573-451-2625, Mon-Fri 8-5; payment is due when you book. Arriving after 5 pm or at a weekend, reserve during office hours first - staff may not be reachable. Check-out 1 pm.

note: City of St. Robert RV park behind Ed Morris Power Sports and Aldi off Missouri Ave, a mile from I-44 and minutes from the Fort Leonard Wood main gate; walk to restaurants and shops. --Claude
summary: City page + Park With Us engine: back-in $30 / pull-through $40 a night (weekly and monthly too), 20 FHU 30/50A sites, back-ins 45 ft, pull-throughs 80 ft, online booking. Public can book an ordinary night: 4/7/11 of 20 sites open on three Tuesdays. Website and phone have moved (new city page; Parks Dept 573-451-2625).
flags: PUBLIC NIGHT (local): yes - the city markets it to visitors 'for training, to see someone graduate ... for a job, or just passing through' and sells single nights on its Park With Us engine. Occupancy check (24-ft rig, 1 night): Tue 2026-12-08 4 of 20 sites open (sites 2,3,5,11, pull-throughs); Tue 2027-01-12 7 of 20 open; Tue 2027-05-11 11 of 20 open (incl. back-ins 15,17,20 at $30). Heavy Fort Leonard Wood use, but well above 1 site in 10 bookable for a night. Weekly/monthly rates marketed ('come for the season'); local, so the long-stay drop rule is moot, but it passes test 4 anyway.

WEBSITE: replace https://www.saintrobert.com/383/City-of-St-Robert-RV-Park (old CivicPlus path; the city site is now Apptegy) with https://www.saintrobert.com/page/city-of-st-robert-rv-park. Booking engine: https://parkwith.us/camps/st-robert-rv-park.

PHONE: stored 573-451-2000 is the City Hall switchboard; the RV page and Google give the Parks Department line 573-451-2625 for reservations (the park map gives '(573) 451-2000 Ext. 1100'). Suggest 573-451-2625.
